description: Look up Census FIPS codes by name. Supports state name or 2-letter code, ZIP code (5 digits), and (for state) substring matching. Use this to find the FIPS codes needed by other census_* tools.

level.description: Optional filter: state, county, zcta, place.

query.description: Free-text: state name ('Texas'), state code ('TX'), or 5-digit ZIP ('77301').

name: census_geography_lookup
